title: BHP Billiton Ltd - proposed acquisition of Rio Tinto Ltd and Rio Tinto plc
targets:
Rio Tinto plc
Rio Tinto Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced.
ACCC requested further information from BHP Billiton. ACCC timeline suspended.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC received partial response from BHP Billiton to the information request of 17 June 2008.
ACCC received outstanding information from BHP Billiton in response to the information request of 17 June 2008. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC requested further information from BHP Billiton. ACCC timeline suspended.
Former proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings of 13 August, amended to allow for BHP Billiton's response to the information request of 22 July 2008.
ACCC received further information from BHP Billiton. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining potential competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties regarding the Statement of Issues. ACCC timeline suspended pending receipt of further information requested from BHP Billiton.
ACCC received further information from BHP Billiton. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.
